Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified the nationality of the director as British instead of American due to misinterpreting the search results. The search results indicated the director was David Lean, a British director, but the actual director was Robert (Bobe) Cannon, an American. The WebSurfer failed to disambiguate between the two films with the same title, leading to an incorrect nationality assignment.
